caseNameFull: Maneja v. Waialua Agricultural Co., Ltd. and Waialua Agricultural Co., Ltd. v. Maneja
attorneys: Richard Gladstein and Norman Leonard for Maneja et al., Rufus G. Poole, Milton C. Denbo and Philip Levy for the Waialua Agricultural Co., Ltd. Solicitor General Sobeloff filed a memorandum for the Secretary of Labor, as amicus curiae.

opinions.text: *870C. A. 9th Cir. Certiorari granted. The Solicitor General is invited to participate in oral argument on behalf of the Secretary of Labor, as amicus curiae.
